T_down.definition: 1 if the close-to-close return over the next 5 trading days < -0.02

T_volexp.definition: 1 if next-5-day realized vol (sqrt of sum of daily log-return squared, annualized) > trailing 60-day median of that 5-day RV series

holdout_rule: A target at date t uses the forward window t+1 onward. That window must not cross into the holdout when the row is used for development or validation.
